I've verified round 27 independently, and the result is **FAIL**. One measured check missed its threshold within the allowed attempts, and several sub-checks could not be run because the dev server at `127.0.0.1:5173` is down. I did not start it.

The previous C session crashed mid-run on 10-11, after collecting most of the live measurements. I re-checked the code tree today: it is byte-identical to the one those measurements ran on (HEAD `c5ed47b`, 60 OK, 62 status lines). So yesterday's runs are valid evidence for today's report.

**Bugs for B:**
- **C-R27-01 (Medium):** the video drift check missed its limit. The limit is 30.1 ms (round 26's 20.1 ms plus 10). Four of five runs went over it: 81.7, 36.2, 46.1, 20.6 and 41.6 ms. Every run also logged 2 hard video seeks, against 0 in round 26. In two control runs I replaced the new track-meter reads with zeros, and drift was still bad (60.4 and 130.6 ms). So the new meters are probably not the cause. But round 26 measured with the music track muted, so the cause is still open. The next step is a run on round 26's layout in a quiet Chrome.
- **C-R27-02 (Low):** two of the eight frozen test files fail under load. When the eight run together, two of three runs failed: one timeout in the track-layout fold test, and one assertion in the render-budget test (expected 0, got 0.051). Both pass alone, and the full suite passes 1096/1096.

**Passed:**
- **Gates:** type check clean; the full suite above; the four new test files listed in the task; the build. Biome reports 0 errors and the same 218 warnings + 1 info as round 26. Protected files are unchanged. Anonymous users get no token and no restricted requests, so premium auth is not bypassed.
- **Per-track meters:** with one track soloed, each track meter matches the measured audio output within 0.05 dB for music (3 runs), stems and video. Unsoloed, every meter equals its soloed value.
- **Mute, Solo, Volume and Master ΓêÆ6 dB:**
  - Mute and Solo bring the meter to silence within the time limit, 3 of 3 runs.
  - Halving the music Volume lowers its meter by exactly 6.0 dB.
  - At Master ΓêÆ6 dB, the SFX meter shows its over warning while the Master stays clear.
- **Other behaviour:** the over warning stays lit, and Master Peak clears it. Pause drops all meters to silence. A meter still moves when its lane is folded. Nothing re-renders per frame during playback.
- **Export:** the WAV matches round 26 exactly: 864,000 frames, 1800 samples at full scale, RMS ΓêÆ15.481 dBFS.
- **Layout and code:** the header controls' positions are unchanged at all four lane heights. The 1280 keyboard Tab order is unchanged. The code diff stays within the allowed files. All six required mutations make a test fail. Implementation doc 033 is complete.

**Partial or not passed:**
- **SFX meter vs audio output:** while the sound fades out, the meter reads 7ΓÇô15 dB above the actual output. The Master meter does exactly the same, because the meter falls at a fixed 20 dB/s and Soft impact fades faster than that. A model of that fall rate matches within 0.11 dB. I didn't mark it PASS because the ┬▒1.0 dB rule as written doesn't hold here. B needs to rewrite that rule for sounds that fade.
- **Blocked by the server outage:**
  - Tab order at 1440, and Space on M.
  - The floating video position and size.
  - Reset when there is something to Redo.
  - A live count of analysers created during export. Only the code diff and a unit test cover it.
  - Track Mute de-click, the loop seam and the library drop.
  - The text of the SSR NUL-byte labels (C-R23-01) after the page loads.
- **C-R23-01 (SSR NUL bytes):** still 4 NUL bytes, now at 28013/28014 and 58733/58734. The second pair moved again, so it is not fixed.
- **Over-warning size:** the warning cue is only a 4 px square. I left it to the Tech Lead's R27-T check rather than calling it a bug.

The report and JSON also carry forward the root review and publication-checkpoint items. I changed no app source; the mutation scratch copy is outside `store/` and its temporary `node_modules` link is removed. When the server is back, `c-round-27/setup.sh` resumes the blocked list.
